note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as reported 18 Nov 2026 (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on every entry). Guides are written in our own words for this entry; where a method is not confirmed at launch the guide says so instead of guessing.

S1.name: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies
S1.what: Official names, descriptions and grades as shown on PSN, taken 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements.

S2.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List
S2.what: Full list with grades; the one confirmed missable (Lucia's Chapter 1 meditation spot); no mission replay and no New Game Plus; several trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch.

S3.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
S3.what: Platinum roadmap; 1 potentially missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude); 18 meditation spots; all 55 offline, single-player.

S4.name: CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements
S4.what: GTABase and PowerPyx both flag Positive Mental Attitude as the only trophy that may be missable; cheats disable trophies and saving.

S5.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements
S5.what: Same 55 on Xbox (1,000 Gamerscore); no online trophies — every trophy is single-player.

S6.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List
S6.what: Grade split (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze); 28 hidden, 27 visible; roadmap order.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then side strands, then collectibles, then activities) and save the 100% completion gold for last; this trophy follows it. Expect a long hunt: early estimates put the platinum around 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it pops at the end of the mission. Play through the intro as directed — no special requirement, no difficulty setting matters. This is the first trophy most players will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: it is the one meditation spot that disappears after this chapter (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, because the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. This is also the chapter where both protagonists become playable, which opens up most of the side activities — use the gaps between story missions to try activities and collectibles as you go, so the endgame cleanup is shorter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Several robbery and wanted-level trophies unlock from Chapter 3 onward, so once the chapter is done, free-roam is the best time to start the crime-related trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Sneakthief) while you are already out in the city.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. After this chapter only the finale remains, so before starting the final mission, make a manual save — it is your safety net for anything tied to the ending, and the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to earn this gold. Save manually right before the finale: with no mission replay, that save is the only way back if you want to re-experience the ending or check anything tied to it. After the credits, free-roam opens up for the full cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks naturally as you play through the chapters — just follow the story markers. No special condition: finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is part of the main story path, so it cannot be skipped or missed as long as you keep playing the story. Finish the mission's objectives and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks by playing the story — there is no alternate route and no way to fail it permanently; if a mission attempt fails, just retry it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story mission trophies all work the same way: reach the mission in the story, finish it, and the trophy is yours. Keep a chapter-start save as a habit, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. The airport area matters again later for Catch Me If You Can, so learn the layout while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the later story missions, so it arrives naturally near the end of your playthrough. Finish it and the trophy is earned.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist — the biggest single trophy in the list (100 Gamerscore on Xbox). The checklist covers the story, side strands, activities, collectibles and challenges, so this gold is really a summary of everything else: finish the story, all 8 stranger strands, the activity and collectible trophies, and the challenge count, then check the in-game stats page for what is left. Do it last, right before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the running total, which PlayStation tracks for you. Stunts accumulate naturally while driving, so do not grind this early: play normally, then mop up the remainder late in the game by chaining jumps off ramps and bridges in a fast car. Any vehicle works; the count is cumulative across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, bowling, arcade games, shooting range, drone racing, street racing, meditation, hunting and the WAiNK app are the kinds the game offers. You only need one attempt at each — no wins required — so knock this out early in free-roam by sampling everything once, and it doubles as a tour of what the game offers.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit any shooting range (ammunition stores run them) and work through the weapon drills one by one; gold means hitting the score threshold, not just completing the drill. Use cover and steady aim rather than rushing — Combat Focus slows time, which helps on the timed drills.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race; you need a win at every one, not just one win. Learn the racing line first with a practice run, then race to win — cutting corners through gates cleanly matters more than top speed. The race markers appear once you find the Top Fun spots around Leonida.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Street races, drone races and other race types all count toward the total, which makes this a good companion to Top Fun: work through the race markers across the map and tick them off. A faster car and a clean first corner help more than anything else.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge, then out-fish him: keep tension on the line without snapping it, reel steadily when the fish runs toward you, and ease off when it fights. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that one pair naturally.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through — any cabinet in any arcade counts. Pick the game you find easiest and play it to completion; you do not need a high score, just a finished run. Arcades are scattered around Vice City, and the first completion is all this trophy asks.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses and their missions appear on the map — follow Andy's markers whenever they show up so the strand does not get left behind. The final mission of each strand has its own trophy, so there are five of these to collect (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Kenton's missions appear as side content alongside the story; do them when they appear rather than saving them all for the end, so you do not have to hunt for a strand you forgot. This is one of five side-character finale trophies.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Billy's strand is one of the five side-character arcs with a finale trophy. Check the map for his markers between story missions and clear them as you go.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as ? markers on the map once you are near them — stop and do them when you find them, because the strands are scattered all over the state and are easy to walk past. Eight completed strands earn this silver; the five named character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies, so this one is about the strangers. This also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Randy's missions show up as side content during the story; clear them when they appear. One of the five side-character finale trophies.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone is the fifth and last of the side-character arcs with a finale trophy — once all five are done, the only strand work left is the 8 stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and this is the ONE trophy widely flagged as missable. Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. For the other spots, use the WAiNK app to find them and meditate at each as you travel; the tracker counts them, so check your progress regularly. Sources: GTABase and PowerPyx (via CryptoGames) and Output Lag both flag this as the only potentially missable trophy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting strand points you to a specific animal — follow his directions to the hunting grounds, track it, and take the shot cleanly. Hunting uses its own mechanics (scent, wind, quiet approach), so move slowly and use cover. This is a single hunt, not a hunting total.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden all over Leonida — in shops, alleys, interiors and out-of-the-way spots — and each set needs every card in it. Use the WAiNK app to scan unfamiliar locations: it highlights points of interest and helps you spot card locations you would otherwise walk past. Collecting is cumulative, so pick cards up whenever you see them and finish sets in the endgame cleanup.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Open WAiNK at any unfamiliar vehicle, landmark or point of interest and scan it; each new location counts once toward the 100. This pairs perfectly with the collectible hunt: scan everything as you explore, and the count climbs on its own. By the time you have explored all 52 areas for The Goodtime State, you will be most of the way there.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small objectives — driving feats, combat feats, exploration goals — and they accumulate across the whole playthrough. You do not need to chase a specific list: play broadly (drive, fight, explore, use activities) and the count rises. Check the challenges menu to see which ones you are close to, and mop up the easiest ones in the endgame.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Get the wanted level up in a quiet area (stealing cars and causing chaos raises it fast), then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear — alleys, tunnels and the countryside help. Your partner must be with you when the stars clear, so do not let them get separated during the escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is that the level must stay active the whole time, so you need to move fast between shops before the cops lose you. Pick three shops close together, plan the route first, and rob each quickly (aim at the clerk, grab the cash, leave). If the wanted level drops to zero between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or scan each new model once and it counts. The WAiNK app helps here: scan unfamiliar vehicles as you pass them. Variety matters, not duplicates, so try everything: cars, bikes, boats, trucks and the odd vehicle you find in the countryside. This climbs naturally if you drive something different every session.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time — activate it in a firefight with at least 5 enemies in view, then pick them off quickly with headshots before the effect ends. A good spot is any mission or shootout with a group of enemies in the open; use cover, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills. If you run out of time, retry the fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, take a plane and leave the airport without a schedule, i.e. steal a plane and take off. Get onto the tarmac (the VCIA Takedown mission teaches you the layout), grab a plane, and get airborne. Expect a wanted level on the way in; a fast approach and a quick takeoff beat a firefight on the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This trophy is about Rhino tanks — the official description is a joke line, not an instruction, and no guide had a confirmed method at launch. The most likely reading: get into (or deal with) a Rhino tank in free-roam, which usually means reaching a military area or a high wanted level. Treat this one as unconfirmed: check a current community guide before grinding for it, and do not trust a method that cites no source.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected — stealth is the whole trophy. Case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If anyone spots you, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die down, and try again with a slower approach. A suppressed weapon and patience help more than speed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vault robberies are the bigger heist-style jobs: plan the entry, crack or force the vault, grab the cash, and escape the wanted level that follows. Each vault counts once, so you need five different vault jobs — spread them across the map and use fast getaway cars and escape routes you scouted in advance. This is one of the silver crime trophies, so expect resistance on the way out.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city — intercept one, stop it (ram it or block the road), get the crew out, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. A heavy vehicle for the ram and a fast car for the getaway, parked nearby in advance, make this much easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited, so the work is simply going everywhere: every district of Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the small towns and the countryside. Use the WAiNK app while you travel — scanning locations also feeds You WAiNKer!, so the two trophies progress together. The last few areas are usually the remote ones, so save a dedicated road trip for the end.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and get out. The gang matters: the same operation hit twice does not count twice, so you need one per gang. Scout the locations during free-roam and work through the list gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger had no confirmed method at launch — the likely reading is ordering a drink at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach with the ocean in view — so treat the details as unconfirmed and check a current community guide before going out of your way. What is certain: it happens on Ocean Beach, and it is a small moment, not a mission.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic GTA style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. The exact showroom and trigger had no confirmed method at launch, so check a current community guide for the spot; the spirit of the trophy is the classic showroom smash from the series' past. Treat the specifics as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish a game there. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that one pair up: go to the alley, play a full game, and both progress. Aim for a full game rather than a single frame.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — a partnership moment with mass appeal — and no guide had a confirmed method at launch. It is most likely tied to a specific story or side moment involving both protagonists, so play through the story and side strands and watch for a partnership set-piece. Treat any specific method as unconfirmed until a guide with a source confirms it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy, so it is about accumulating decisions over a playthrough, not one single choice. Choose actively whenever the game offers a decision (dialogue options, side-strand choices, approach choices) instead of always taking the default. Because choices are one-time by nature, treat this as possibly missable in the sense that skipped choices cannot be re-made — keep a chapter-start save as a safety net. The exact count mechanics are unconfirmed at launch.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description suggests retrying something you failed once and then getting it right. No guide had a confirmed method at launch: it may be tied to a specific retryable moment, so do not grind blindly for it. If you fail a mission or activity and then succeed on the retry, this may pop on its own during normal play; check a current community guide if it has not popped by the endgame.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — this is the game's oddity trophy, and no guide had a confirmed method at launch. It is most likely tied to a random event, an easter egg or a scripted weird moment somewhere in Leonida. Explore the odd corners of the map (the swamps, the Keys, the remote roads) and keep an eye on community reports; do not trust a method that cites no source.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact mechanics had no confirmed method at launch, so check a current community guide for the setup; the basic idea is a melee swing (not a gun, not the car itself) from a slow-moving vehicle. Treat the specifics as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; they cannot be spent directly, so take them to a laundering contact and convert them into clean cash. The $250,000 is cumulative, so keep laundering after every big score instead of letting bills pile up. This pairs with the robbery trophies — rob, launder, repeat.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, and any shop counts: clothes, weapons, car mods, food. The fastest legitimate way is car customization and weapons, which are expensive by design. Do not force this early: buy what you need as you play, and in the endgame spend the leftover cash on the most expensive items you still want. It will pop on its own for most players before the platinum.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings — check the property app or site regularly as the story progresses, since new properties unlock over time. Each garage gives you storage, and owning all 8 earns the trophy. Save money for them: they are a real expense, so do not blow everything on car mods first.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you own or discover, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — 10 registrations earn the trophy. This pairs with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles): discover a vehicle, then register it if it is worth keeping. The app is on your in-game phone.
trophies.name: On the Spot
